name: natural-writing
description: Write and edit prose that avoids the documented signs of AI writing from Wikipedia's field guide.

interface.shortDescription: Avoid AI writing tells in any prose.
interface.longDescription: Drafts, rewrites, and audits prose against the full catalog of AI writing signs from Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing: inflated significance, AI vocabulary, negative parallelisms, bold-label lists, chat artifacts, fabricated citations, and more. Prefers the live Wikipedia page as source of truth with a bundled offline snapshot. House rule: no dashes as punctuation.
defaultPrompt: Humanize this text and remove the AI tells.
